text: ポケモンが　タマゴを　もって　おったんじゃ！

structure.jp: タマゴを　もって　おったんじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ておった is the old-man form of ていた, which says something was going on. もって　おった = 'was holding'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んじゃ is the old-man form of んだ, which gives the feeling of explaining what happened. もって　おったんじゃ = 'it was holding one, you see'.
